qualifiers.condition: use of a data key outside AWS KMS is not reflected in the last usage information; for some AWS services you must not rely on last usage alone to decide whether a key can be deleted

evidence.quote: AWS KMS provides usage information on the last successful cryptographic operation performed with each KMS key along with the associated CloudTrail event ID. This can ease the process of identifying unused KMS keys.
After a data key is generated from a symmetric KMS key, its subsequent use for local encryption or decryption outside of AWS KMS is not reflected in the last usage information.
In these cases, you must not rely on the last usage information alone to determine if a KMS key can be deleted.
